name: catscan
description: On-device visual checks for screenshots and video on macOS.

scripts.docs:check: node scripts/docs-check.mjs && node scripts/check-internal.mjs --allowlist && node bench/languages/table.js --check
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:swift && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --test packages/core-js/test/*.test.js packages/mcp/test/*.test.js packages/playwright/test/*.test.js bench/test/*.test.js bench/overlap/lab/test/*.test.js scripts/test/*.test.mjs scripts/lab/test/*.test.mjs test/skills/runners/*.test.mjs && npm run test:types
scripts.test:packages: node --test packages/core-js/test/*.test.js packages/mcp/test/*.test.js packages/playwright/test/*.test.js && node scripts/pack-smoke.mjs && node --test test/upgrade/fixture.test.js
scripts.test:playwright: playwright test -c packages/playwright/test/e2e && node packages/playwright/test/example-run.js && node --test test/adopt/fixture.test.js
